acquisition_method: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode
alkylation_concentration: alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
alkylation_reagent: alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
cleavage_agent: subjected to trypsin digestion and LC-MS/MS analysis.
enrichment_method: the annotated HEAT and ARM proteins that were enriched in the C10:0 and C14:0 lipid bead SILAC pull down experiments
fractionation_method: Proteins from SILAC pull-down experiments were separated by SDS-PAGE and subjected to in-gel tryptic digest.
fragmentation_method: followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap
instrument: analyzed with an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC
mass_analyzer: full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
